items.text: Kosodi kanen, kapaarasia kanun naamamear ekabaka koIsirael, ajai Elebit loiboie kosane loka akwap nakiukon naka Epuraim, loabu koyana abusiat koBet-lekem-yuda.
Kolot akebusiat eporo bala naadote, konyou kamake, kolot togo loka papake Bet-Iekem-yuda, kiboi kanen ilapio iwonon,
Konyou okilenike, kibwapa ŋes, aimaima ŋes, ainyakun ŋes, kojai ebulesitike kaŋes, ka asigiria aarei: koyana nin ŋes togo loka papake: keanyu papa loka apese ŋes, abu kolakar airiamun kaŋes.
Kosodi ekamuranike, papa loka apese aitapaikin ŋes; kiboioto kaŋes apaarasia auni: konyamata, komatata, koperoto nen.
Kosodi kanen kapaaran nakiwononet, kodilokis anyoun tupuruc, konyou alosit: kotema papa loka apese ekamuranike atiar, “Kitalaka ekonitau kidionyamat, kosodi konyet alosit.”
Kiboikinos, konyamata, komatata, kes kere iarei: kotema papa loka apese etuŋanan atiar, “Kenainait, kocam kitiwala akuare kere, kiyalamikin ekonitau.”
Konyou etuŋanan alosit; konye kimaima ekamuranike, kopere bobo nen.
Kodilok anyoun alosit tupuruc kapaaran nakikanyet; kotema papa loka apese atiar, “Kitalaka ekonitau kenainait, kidareu aitodol ajotet”; konyamata kesi kere iarei.

Kosodi kenyou etuŋanan alosit, ŋes ka akebusiat ka ekebulesit, kotema ekamuranike, papa loka apese ŋes atiar, “Koany, etibon kwana akwap, kenainait kitiwala akuare kere: koany, eapie apaaran adaun, kopero ne, kolakar ekonitau; kodilok moi alosit, tetere ilosi ore.”
Konye koner etuŋanan aitiwalar akuare nin konye abu konyou kolot, kodol Yebus (nopenol ŋes Yerusalem): ajaas ŋes asigiria aarei nuapesikinitai aibwanenisio; ajai da abusiatake kaŋes.
Naaapikiniata kesi Yebus, kitibonite akwap eut; kotema ebulesit ekejakait atiar, “Keŋaiŋait, bia kapaasi ore lo loka Iyebusin, kaperoto nen.”
“Mam oni kipaari ore loka emoit, lomam erai loka idwe luka Isirael; konye kitubor kiton Gibea.”
Kotema ŋesi ekebulesit atiar, “Bia, kekunyakisi adiopet kaiboisio kanu; kiperi da Gibea, arai Rama.”
Kwaŋin kotuboros koloto; kowarik kes akwap eiduny keGibea, loerai loka Benyamin,
Kopaasi ŋina, alosit apero Gibea: abu koloma, kiboikin orot loka ere: naarai amamei ituŋanan yenabu koyana kes togoke apero.
Ido koany, abu emojoŋ kobu kaswamuke komanikor eboŋ; erai etuŋanan ŋol loka akwap nakiukon naka Epuraim, eboie da koGibea: konye ituŋa luka aibois araas Ibenyamin.
Kiteluo akekonye koany ekaloton korot loka ere; kotema emoion atiar, “Ai bo ilosi ijo? Lali da kibunio?”

Kotema ŋes atiar, “Kilosi anyoun kolset-lekem-yuda kiton osaŋe loka akwap nakiukon naka Epuraim; bukosi nina, abu kalosite Bet-lekem-yuda: ido alosi kwana togo loka EJAKAIT; konye emamei etuŋanan loketolomari eoŋ togoke.
Kwabo ejaas anya ka inyamat luka asigiriakosi; ejaas da imugatin ka ebino kanukan, ka akejaanakinanikon, ka ekatumunan loejaas ka ikejaanakinakakon: emamei eipud idiobore.”
Kotema emoion atiar, “Kinapakin ijo; konye kabe eoŋ eipudakon kere; konye sirikiper orot.”
Kwaŋin koyana ŋes togoke, koinak asigiria anya: kilotata kesi akeicnekee, konyamata, komatata da.
Kelakaros ikecetauon, koany, kolukut ituŋa lukore etogo, kes odwe luka Belial, konanananata ekirigi; kotemasi kesi emojoŋ elopet etogo atiar, “Kitolom etuŋanan loaloma togokon, kaienata ŋes.”
Koloma etuŋanan, elopet etogo, mamakee, kotema kes atiar, “Mam, ikainacan, kenainaito, sirikiswamata aronis naetia nen; naarai alomu etuŋanan ŋol togoka, sirikiswamata nun nuka abaŋaanut.
Koany, akokuka na apese, ka abusiatake; etolomuni eoŋ kes kwana, kitisiloto yesi kes, kiswamakis kes nuitojokito yesi; konye sirikiswamakis etuŋanan ŋ nun nukola abaŋaanut.”
Konye koneroto ituŋa apupun ŋes: kwaŋin kitiŋ etuŋanan akebusiat, koina kes; koienutu ŋes, komunautu ŋes akuare kia kiton tupuruc: keeila kide, koosikis ŋes.
Kosodi aberu abunore keeila kide, kibirokin okek loka etogo loka etuŋanan loajai ejakaitike, aitodol naaeaunia akwap,
Konyou ejakaitike tupuruc, konaa ikekia luka etogo, koloma alosit: ido koany, ebirokina aberu akebusiat okek loka etogo, kojaas akaninike okek,
Kotema ŋesi ŋin atiar, “Konyou, kaloto”; konye mam yenabu Koboŋok: kosodi ŋesi adakakin ŋin asigiria; konyou etuŋanan, kolot aiboisike.
Kedol togoke, abu kolem ekileŋ, kitiŋ akebusiat, kotubutub inerioke atutubeta atomon ka nuarei, kijuka nin oikorun kere luka Isirael.

Kojaun kwanata ebe, apotu kere luapotu koanyutu ŋun kotemasi ebe, “Mam apeŋo eswamatai ibore yenetia nen, karaida aanyun, ageun kapaaran naanyounioto idwe luka Isirael kakwap nako Misiri kiton lolo: koomoomata nuke, kinerut, kolimosi.”
